name: OpenForge v4.0.0 — Sandbox Panel, 20 Planning Tools, Streaming Fixes
body:
## What's new

### User-visible
- **Sandbox Panel** — right-hand sidebar with split Web Preview + PTY Terminal (drag to resize, 50/50 default, collapsible)
- **Working Process dropdown** with nested **Thought Process**; auto-collapses with a one-line summary
- **Ctrl+B** toggles the chat sidebar · **Ctrl+J** toggles the sandbox
- 20 planning tools: task_plan, todo_write, scratchpad_write, think, list_directory, search_files, file_info, project_scaffold, git_status/diff/log/checkpoint, list_ports, process_snapshot, memory_search, session_search, web_fetch, create_tool, plan_and_delegate
- Self-extending: Forge can draft new tools into `~/.openforge/tools/` (auto-loaded next turn)
- `~/.openforge/USER.md` and `~/.openforge/PROCEDURES.md` are now merged into the system prompt every turn

### Bug fixes
- **llama.cpp auto-cancel (`srv stop: cancel task`)**: provider detects `tools` rejection and retries without tools; SSE keepalive pings prevent browser disconnect during long prompt-processing
- **Double-process bug**: `forge/process_manager.py` enforces a PID-based singleton so two `server.py` invocations fail fast instead of double-binding port 8000
- **"(no response)" bug**: provider-level error events now surface to the UI as distinct SSE error frames
- **Terminal box-glyphs**: welcome banner switched to pure ASCII (renders identically in any xterm.js font)
- **Sandbox self-load recursion**: dev-server autodetect skips port 3000 (Forge itself); sandbox defaults to CLOSED unless the user opens it

### Developer experience
- 603 passing tests (up from 531); 36 new tests for the planning toolkit
- E2E suite: `scripts/e2e_hello_world.py` walks write_file → run_terminal_command → verification against llama.cpp
- FILE_ORGANIZATION plan (`.plans/FILE_ORGANIZATION.md`) maps a safe folder-nesting refactor for v5
- RESEARCH_UI_SANDBOX (`.plans/RESEARCH_UI_SANDBOX.md`) documents the hybrid design pulled from Claude, ChatGPT, GLM, and v0

### Docs
- `README.md` rewritten for v4.0.0 (tools table, sandbox screenshot, feature list)
- `CONTINUATION_PROMPT.md` updated with v4.0.0 bootstrap
- `tests/REAL_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md` — real evidence of Forge + Ornith toolchain working end-to-end

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/neuralforgeio/openforge/compare/v3.1.0...v4.0.0
